Made significant progress on my custom MIDI keypad project today! I finalized the component placement in KiCad, routing all the traces for the Kailh Choc low-profile switches, the EC11 rotary encoder, and the slide potentiometers while carefully isolating the capacitive touch traces to avoid any interference. I also positioned the reverse-mounted SK6812 MINI-E Neopixels so they will shine nicely through the board cutouts. Everything passed the Design Rules Check (DRC) cleanly, and I generated the production Gerbers and BOM files via the JLCPCB toolkit. Next up is ordering the fabricated PCB and starting on the KMK firmware configuration!
